name: El Ejido (Spain)
description: Divided by a wavy line green over white, the white charged with four navy blue wavy stripes.
history: The flag of El Ejido is described as a rectangular flag one and a half times longer than wide, divided by a wavy line into two equal stripes, the upper flag green and the lower white charged with four navy blue wavy fesses; the arms were approved by royal decree 2477 of 13 July 1983.

features.role: four wavy stripes on the white
